paragraphs: R' Yaakov bar Acha bar Idi.

Mentioned [at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Demai, chapter 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Demai.1.4.5), reporting in the name of R' Yehoshua ben Levi. Hyman suggests that the same name should also be read in [Moed Katan 27a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.27a.15).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Demai places both patronymics before the attribution to Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, as does [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2095&lang=en). The linked Moed Katan has Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha speaking in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name. Hyman suggests reading the additional bar Idi there.
